description: E-236-08 DEGRADED-opponent acceptance E2E fixture. Sibling to tests/fixtures/e2e/ (the golden oracle) — that set is NOT modified. Same team identity (ExampleTm001) but a deliberately-degraded MIX of games so a full report still RENDERS (N>0) while being degraded (N<M, plays-failing, spray-less). Drives the real generate_report() against a transport-only respx mock; the test (tests/test_report_e2e_degraded.py) registers plays as HTTP 500 and spray as a null-chart payload programmatically (those are degradations, not recorded successes).

degradations.scored_but_empty: sub-case A boxscore (api-scout confirmed 2026-06-14): own=slug/no-dashes + opp=UUID/with-dashes, groups present per-category with EMPTY stats arrays -> games row + score written, 0 stat rows, LoadResult.errors=0 -> load_status=completed, crawl_status=completed. SAME shape as story 09's sub-case-A unit test.

requests.note: Game 1: FULL/charted boxscore -> contributes to N.
Game 2: sub-case A scored-but-empty -> counts toward M, NOT N.
Game 3: sub-case A scored-but-empty (same empty shape) -> counts toward M, NOT N.
ALL plays fetches FAIL with HTTP 500 (registered by the test, no fixture file) -> plays_status=failed.
ALL spray fetches return a null-chart 200 (registered by the test) -> spray_status=completed, spray_games_with_data=0.
